camel_example: aliyun cloudauth VehicleMetaVerifyV2 --region cn-hangzhou --VerifyMetaType VEHICLE_3_META --UserName '张*' --VehicleType 02 --IdentifyNum '4****************1' --ParamType normal --VehicleNum '陕A9****'
description_en: Verifies vehicle attributes by using the enhanced edition
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth vehicle-meta-verify-v2 --param-type normal --vehicle-type 02 --verify-meta-type VEHICLE_3_META --identify-num '4****************1' --user-name '张*' --vehicle-num '陕A9****' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VehicleMetaVerifyV2

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:
normal: not encrypted.
md5: MD5 encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密。
md5：Md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The verification type. Valid values:

VEHICLE_2_META: two-element verification, which verifies the name and license plate number.
VEHICLE_3_META: three-element verification, which verifies the name, license plate number, and ID card number
parameters.help_zh:
核验类型


VEHICLE_2_META：二要素核验，姓名+车牌号核验；
VEHICLE_3_META：三要素核验，姓名+车牌号+身份证号核验；
parameters.name: verify_meta_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number.

This parameter is required when VerifyMetaType is set to VEHICLE_3_META.


When paramType is set to normal, enter the plaintext.
When paramType is set to md5, enter the first 6 digits of the ID card number in plaintext + the 32-bit lowercase MD5 hash of the birth date + the last 4 digits of the ID card number
parameters.help_zh:
身份证号。

当VerifyMetaType取值VEHICLE_3_META，此项必输。


当paramType取值normal时，输入明文 。
当paramType取值md5时，身份证号前6位明文+出生年月日md5加密（32位小写MD5）+身份证号后4位
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The name.

When paramType is set to normal, enter the plaintext.
When paramType is set to md5, enter the 32-bit lowercase MD5 hash of the first character of the name + the rest of the name in plaintext
parameters.help_zh:
姓名

当paramType取值normal时，输入明文。
当paramType取值md5时，姓名第一个字MD5加密（32位小写MD5）+ 姓名其他部分明文
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The license plate number.


When paramType is set to normal, enter the plaintext.
When paramType is set to md5, enter the license plate number except the last two characters in plaintext + the 32-bit lowercase MD5 hash of the last two characters of the license plate
parameters.help_zh:
车牌号


当paramType取值normal时，输入明文。
当paramType取值md5时，输入车牌号除最后两位的其他部分明文+车牌最后两位字母MD5加密（32位小写MD5）
parameters.name: vehicle_num

Code.description_en: The return code. 200 indicates that the API operation is successful
Code.description_zh: 返回码，200表示接口响应成功

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:
1: The verification is consistent.
2: The verification is inconsistent.
3: No record is found
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果码：
1：核验一致。
2：核验不一致。
3：查无记录
